anomalies.observed: The schematic text carries two different values for R48, the pull-up on the gate of Q9 (AO3401A PMOS, which sits next to the +3V3 label). One text layer reads "+3V3 10K R48" and another reads "JP8 ... +5V Q9 AO3401A ... R48 210K". The drawing shows R48 as either 10K or 210K depending on which annotation is read.
anomalies.expected: A gate pull-up on a PMOS load switch like Q9 should use a consistent, low-impedance value that matches the other identical switch pull-ups on this sheet, such as the 10K pull-ups on Q6 (R58) and Q7 (R14). A single unambiguous value is required.

evidence.quote: +3V3 10K R48 (CM4/I/O sheet, sheet 1/1, text near Q9 AO3401A)
JP8 1 2 +5V Q9 AO3401A 1 3 R48 210K (sheet 1/1, text near Q9 AO3401A)

anomalies.impact: If the built value is 210K, the gate of Q9 is pulled up far more weakly, which may slow switching or leave the switch floating-ish under noise. If the 10K value is correct, the discrepancy is only a documentation error. Either way the board's power-switch behaviour may differ from the intended design.
